## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 10-fascicle text by [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) Zhìyuán is the structural-outline (*kē* 科) for [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Dà bān niè pán jīng shū* 大般涅槃經疏 ([KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007), T1767). At 10 fascicles, the *kē* itself is one of the largest in the East Asian Buddhist tradition, reflecting the parent commentary's substantial scope.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (990–1022) reflects Zhìyuán's mature scholarly period.
